review.notes: Research lane: every master inspected at contact-sheet size against the 09-29 hero with the same camera (art208/art-sheet-1..3.jpg); full-size spot checks of verdant, saltwind, cliffbridge, fjord. Fjord withheld (empty-moor framing). Deploy 208 (62b2d2455) dist, Studio mapScene recipe, High preset, day.

verdant.notes: Kolkhoz village, onion-domed church and black ploughland of the PR #9 rebuild in the overview; replaces the pre-redesign generic village.

desert.notes: Rebuilt Sirocco basin with the mesa skyline and the ksar block; same camera as the 09-29 set.

winter.notes: Spruce stands, the village and the frozen lake under the snow massif; current Frosthollow.

urban.notes: The rebuilt Franconian hill town; darker and hazier than the 09-29 shot under the current light model.

coastal.notes: Breton bay, strand and village of the rebuild; water and fields as the game draws them now.

autumn.notes: Amberford river valley with the current autumn woods; fewer orange crowns than the old render.

steppe.notes: Grain elevator and the Virgin Lands steppe of the rebuild.

railyard.notes: Cinder Junction yard with the Ruhr kit buildings under its overcast.

frontier.notes: Hessian Fulda Gap basin with the Fachwerk village; hazier than the 09-29 shot.

delta.notes: Jamuna char village and paddies under dense palms; current Jade River Delta.

badlands.notes: Wadi Rum jebels and the red-sand valley of the Redrock rebuild (r11f in 208); far better than the old pink dome render.

monsoon.notes: Kohima valley with the river and hill town of the rebuild.

alpine.notes: Mont-Cenis saddle with the Savoyard hamlet and the lake; current Glacier Pass.

caldera.notes: Aso caldera floor with paddies and the Kyushu village; replaces the dark pre-revival basin.

foundry.notes: The Saar works with its sheds and slab yards; current Ironworks.

ruinspires.notes: Sarajevo valley city with towers and the boulevard; current Ruinspires.

blackglass.notes: Suzhou Creek with the Bund-style brick towers close to camera; the creek and city behind.

titan_gorge.notes: Monument Valley floor with buttes and the trading post (main state, round 3).

skybridge.notes: Glen Canyon basin with the dam and Page-style town of the revival.

polders.notes: Scheldt polder fields and the village; darker under the current overcast light.

copper_mesa.notes: Queenstown hills and basin with the mine town; same camera as before.

airfield.notes: Hostomel cargo hangar, tower and runway of the Kestrel revival in the foreground.

oasis.notes: Siwa lake and the kershef town of the revival on the desert plain.

whiteout.notes: Whiteout station on its snow basin; reads sparse, as the owner noted; re-shoot after the map-content round.

orchard.notes: The Chouf houses and terraces of the Orchard revival.

longleaf.notes: Louisiana mill town and the longleaf pines of the revival.

mangrove.notes: Ca Mau creeks and houses of the rebuild; one pond glint blows out white (as in the old render).

saltwind.notes: Dalmatian bay, terra rossa fields, the village and bell tower from the seaward ridge camera; much stronger than the old render.

reservoir.notes: Eifel lake and village of the rebuild, valve tower landmark.

mars.notes: Olympus Basin station under the galaxy sky; unchanged composition.

moon.notes: Earthrise Basin with the Earth over the massifs; unchanged composition.

cliffbridge.notes: Ronda gorge town, whitewashed houses and the bridge of the Aegis revival; much stronger than the old render.
